name: Gran Melia Iguazu
positioning: Gran Meliá Iguazú, a resort hotel within Iguazú National Park in Argentina, with views of the Devil's Throat and Iguazú Falls
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside Iguazú National Park, close to the falls
Couples wanting RedLevel rooms with falls views and spa access
Families wanting connected Family Rooms and a children's paddling pool

facts.text: The hotel is located within Iguazú National Park.
Iguazú National Park forms the natural border between Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay and is one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World.
The hotel has views of the Devil's Throat.
The hotel has an infinity pool in front of the Devil's Throat, with a pool concierge service.
Children have their own paddling pool.
The gym has views of Iguazu Falls.
Family Rooms have two connected bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and private balcony.
RedLevel rooms and suites are on the upper floors, with views of the Iguazú falls.
RedLevel rooms include a Nespresso coffee machine, exclusive toiletries and 600-thread count cotton bed linen.
The Yasi Spa hydrotherapy circuit with hydromassage jets is included in the RedLevel category and is reserved for guests over 16.
Alter Rooftop Bar has panoramic views of Iguazu Falls and serves selected wines and signature cocktails.
Asador, under chef Ernesto Palomar, celebrates open-flame cooking that combines Argentine tradition with a contemporary perspective.

highlights.text: The two-story Royal Suite RedLevel has a terrace with a private heated infinity pool.
Under the Full Moon takes guests to the Devil's Throat balcony by moonlight on full moon nights.
The Rainforest Ecological train to the Devil's Throat trail leaves from outside the hotel.
Yasi Spa treatments and rituals use exclusive yerba mate products.

considerations.text: Every guest must buy a park ticket on the Iguazu National Park website and show it at check-in to access the hotel; park entrance is not included in the room rate.
The hotel's own activities are exclusive to Meliá Rewards members and may vary by season.
WhataHotel notes the remote rainforest location requires planned transportation.

sources.title: Gran Meliá Iguazú - Unbeatable experiences in Iguazú National Park
